## Predicting alternatively spliced protein isoform stability

![Overview of the isoform-stability project](images/isoform-project.jpg)

### Question

How does alternative splicing alter the stability and functional
potential of human proteins?

### Approach

I develop computational models that integrate protein sequence,
transcript annotation, structural features, and machine-learning
predictions.

### Significance

This work aims to distinguish stable protein products from isoforms
that are unlikely to form functional proteins.

## Molecular dynamics and protein thermal stability

![Molecular-dynamics workflow](images/md-project.jpg)

### Question

Can molecular-dynamics simulations reveal how sequence variation
influences protein thermal stability?

### Approach

I compare structural behavior across simulation temperatures using
measures such as conformational fluctuation, compactness, and
secondary-structure retention.

### Significance

The project connects experimental stability measurements with
atomistic descriptions of protein behavior.
